summary: Full backend + frontend validation for GameLife Valutazioni app. All 6 backend pytest tests passed (root, search, product live+cache, invalid URL rejection, history GET/DELETE/restore). Live scrape of Zelda ToTK returned exact expected values (nuovo=80.99, usato=59.99, buyback=20.0). Cache hit was <3s (fast path). Frontend flows all working: Cerca renders 20 rows with progressive price loading & buyback pills; add-to-quote-button increments Preventivo badge; Preventivo screen shows VideogamesItalia logo, customer-input, correctly sums buyback (verified € 38,00 = 20 + 18 for Zelda ToTK + BOTW); share-pdf-button present & enabled; Cronologia lists valued games and clear-history empties list. Minor deprecation warnings in console (shadow* props, pointerEvents) — non-blocking. No React Native red screens, no expo-av / expo-barcode-scanner / expo-background-fetch deprecated packages detected. Cover thumbnails blank as expected (Cloudflare 403 hotlink block from datacenter IP — per E1 note).

issues: Console warns: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated — recommend migrating to 'boxShadow' per RN 0.76+. Also 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated' — use style.pointerEvents. Not blocking but noisy.

action_items: (Optional/low priority) Replace deprecated 'shadow*' style props in /app/frontend/src/theme (shadow.raised) with 'boxShadow' to silence RN Web deprecation warning.
(Optional/low priority) Audit for 'pointerEvents' prop usage and migrate to style.pointerEvents.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py cleanly excludes MongoDB _id via Pydantic response_models — good.
Concurrency limited via asyncio.Semaphore(4) for Playwright fetches — good.
Cache TTL 24h + soft-delete via deleted_at, and product endpoint $unset deleted_at on view — correctly implements the 'clear history then re-viewing restores' spec.
Frontend uses process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL correctly; all interactive elements have testID.
scraper.py retry loop (3 attempts) with fresh browser context per attempt — good resilience.
seed_data_creation: None. Tests use live GameLife.it scrape for Zelda ToTK.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend base URL from EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. Zelda ToTK canonical test URL: https://www.gamelife.it/sws20003-the-legend-of-zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom (nuovo=80.99, usato=59.99, buyback=20.0). Cold /api/product can take 5-15s; warm/cached call <1s. Cover images 403 from datacenter — expected. Accessories (Amiibo/LEGO) legitimately have no usato/buyback shown as '—'. Preventivo store persists via AsyncStorage under key 'preventivo_items_v1' — clear it between test runs if you need a pristine state (tap 'clear-preventivo' on Preventivo tab).
rca_of_issue: No bug encountered. Everything works as specified.
